name: co2-ppm
title: CO2 PPM - Trends in Atmospheric Carbon Dioxide (Mauna Loa, monthly)
description: Monthly mean atmospheric carbon dioxide (CO2) mole fraction in dry air, in parts per million, measured at Mauna Loa Observatory, Hawaii, from March 1958 to July 2026. Compiled by NOAA Global Monitoring Laboratory (GML). Values from March 1958 to April 1974 were measured by C. David Keeling of the Scripps Institution of Oceanography (SIO); NOAA measurements start in May 1974. Because of the eruption of Mauna Loa, measurements from December 2022 to July 4, 2023 come from a site at the Maunakea Observatories, about 21 miles north. Snapshot of NOAA's file retrieved 2026-08-30 (file created 2026-08-05).

fields.name: decimal_date
fields.description: The month as a decimal year, as given by NOAA (the middle of the month, e.g. 2026.5417 for July 2026).

fields.name: co2_ppm
fields.description: Monthly mean CO2 mole fraction in dry air, parts per million (ppm). NOAA builds it from daily means and corrects it to the centre of the month using the average seasonal cycle. Months with no measurements have been interpolated by NOAA, which says it marks them with negative (here: empty) sdev and uncertainty. In this snapshot only one NOAA-era month has no day count, 1975-12 (empty n_days and daily_sdev_ppm, uncertainty_ppm 0.00); for 1958-03 to 1974-04 (SIO) n_days, daily_sdev_ppm and uncertainty_ppm are always empty, so interpolated SIO months cannot be told apart.

fields.name: co2_deseasonalized_ppm
fields.description: Monthly mean CO2 with the average seasonal cycle removed, ppm (NOAA's 'deseasonalized' column).

fields.name: n_days
fields.description: Number of days with data in the month. Empty where NOAA gives no information (source sentinel -1): all of the SIO period (March 1958 to April 1974) and interpolated NOAA months.

fields.name: daily_sdev_ppm
fields.description: Standard deviation of the daily means within the month, ppm. Empty where NOAA gives no information (source sentinel -9.99): all of the SIO period and interpolated NOAA months.

fields.name: uncertainty_ppm
fields.description: Uncertainty of the monthly mean, ppm. Empty where NOAA gives no information (source sentinel -0.99). Kept verbatim from the source: two months (1975-12 and 1984-04) carry 0.00 although their daily_sdev_ppm is empty, which NOAA does not document as a sentinel.
